title: fix(scenarios): give asset_lifecycle's DR-0006 a scrap reason that fits a near-new monitor
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Eppyg9rqKqRzXszSbc9VqR)_

Fixes #34111

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：资产卡 `asset_lifecycle` 里报废申请 DR-0006 的报废原因，从「背光故障，维修报价高于换新」改成「搬库房时摔落、面板碎裂，属意外损坏不在保修内，换面板比买新显示器还贵」。资产、日期、折旧和所有真值都不变。
- 为什么改：这台显示器买来才七周，账面价值 1,770/1,800,原原因读起来就该走保修，谨慎的经理(和谨慎的 AI)会停下来不批，卡上却期望「已批准」，等于在考运气；18:45Z 的画廊刷新两半都因此失分。
- 风险与回滚：只动一张卡的一句文本，外加一个 patch changeset(卡片随 `@objectstack/scenarios` 的 `dist/library` 发布);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/scenarios/asset_lifecycle.json` 的 `dr06` 一行；再看 changeset `.changeset/34111-asset-lifecycle-scrap-reason.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`,预期 34 个文件 894 项全过(卡片 loader 与真值测试都在其中)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`docs/qa/scenarios/asset_lifecycle.json`, scrap request `dr06` (DR-0006, asset `a102` / AST-0102): the `reason` now reads "Dropped during the stock-room move; the panel is shattered. Accidental damage is not covered, and a new panel costs more than a new monitor." Nothing else in the card moves.

Route chosen: the card's second option (a reason that fits a near-new asset), as the seat leaned. The first option (back-date AST-0102 by two years) would move its purchase date, its depreciation entries, `accumulated_depreciation`, `book_value` and every 问数 truth that sums them, and it would break the seed rule in the card's `$comment` (assets 91-120 bought in September), which every other truth is worked from. The new reason names accidental damage, which no warranty covers, and keeps the word "warranty" out, so the `laptop_warranty_expiring` truth (`unanswerable`: no seeded object records a warranty) still holds.

Truths recomputed: none change. `reason` is free text that no truth, question or operation reads (`grep` over the card and `packages/qa/scenarios/{src,test}`: the only readers of `dr06`/`a102` are the operation's status and `decided_on` fields and the asset status, all unchanged).

Changeset: `@objectstack/scenarios` patch. The dispatch order said a card-JSON-only diff takes `skip-changeset`, but `scripts/pack-library.mjs` copies `docs/qa/scenarios/*.json` into the package's `dist/library`, so this diff changes the published tarball; AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3) keeps `skip-changeset` for a diff that publishes nothing.

## Sweep of the nine cards

Every operation across the nine cards that expects `applied` for an approval or decision, read against its seeded facts:

| Card · operation | Target | Reading | Action |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `asset_lifecycle` · `manager_approves_scrap` | DR-0006 | near-new monitor, repair-vs-replace reason | **fixed** (this PR) |
| `leave_balances` · `manager_approves_step_one` | LR-0102 (e06, 1 day on 2026-10-16) | balance has 1.5 days left, request is 1 day, filed 2026-09-18, single step | clean, unchanged |
| `travel_expense` · `manager_approves_step_one` | EC-0111 (e03, 1,810) | approved trip TR-0111 matches the dates, every line within standard, under the trip's 2,100 estimate | clean, unchanged |
| `order_to_cash` · `approve_discount` | SO-0110 (Cedar Logistics, 4,700) | 20% hardware discount, inside the card's 30% ceiling; but Cedar has INV-1074 (10,200) 10 days overdue and a collection call every cycle | **listed, not changed**: the card states no credit rule, the account always pays in full, and the discount is the seed's routine one |
| `requisition_to_receipt` · `manager_approves_level_one` | PR-0111 (e03 Sales, rack servers 48,000) | Sales' received requisitions already total 372,400 against a 300,000 purchasing budget the manager can see; the same requester's identical PR-0027 was rejected "Not in this quarter's plan" | **listed, not changed**: the prompt gives the budget no period and no approval rule, and raising it would move the `department_budgets` truth and its two pins in `requisition-to-receipt.test.ts`; a live run should say whether agents pause here |

Also noted, not an operation target: `asset_lifecycle` DR-0005 (AST-0114, bought 2026-09-24, "Flickering panel; replacing it costs less than the repair quote") has the same near-new shape, but only the question `dr_0005_waiting_on` (who it waits on) reads it, and no operation asks to approve it.

## Acceptance notes

- PR-0111 budget overrun and SO-0110 late payer: listed above for the seat; no defect class (a|b|c) applies, these are card-data judgement calls.
